blurb: Belfair Farms Riding Academy provides hunter/jumper and equitation horseback riding lessons and horse boarding in Van Wyck, SC near Charlotte, NC. We offer beginner riding lessons, youth and adult programs, IEA team training, summer riding camps, and competitive show preparation from local to A-rated horse shows. With 25+ years of experience, we are a trusted riding school and boarding barn for families and riders
